summary: Cheer Holding, Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its notice and proxy statement for the 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for July 7, 2026, in Beijing. The meeting will cover routine corporate matters such as director elections and other standard proposals. No special-situations event—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change—is described. The filing is a standard proxy solicitation for an annual meeting, not a special situation. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K serves the purpose of a U.S. proxy statement under Rule 13a-16. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angles to monitor.
